question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

CLEAR
solution: The correct answer is '**Murky**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Clear**' is '**Murky**'. • **Clear**: easy to see, hear or understand. (देखने, सुनने या समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट, साफ़) • *Example: His voice wasn’t very **clear** on the telephone.* • **Murky**: dark and dirty; not clear. (अंधेरा और गंदा; स्पष्ट नहीं) • *Example: The water in the river looked very **murky**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Murky.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning** of other words: • **Black**: of the darkest colour, like night or coal. [काला (रंग) (रात या कोयले जैसा)] • **Clean**: not dirty. (साफ़, निर्मल, स्‍वच्‍छ) • **White**: of the very light colour of fresh snow or milk. [सफ़ेद या श्‍वेत रंग का (ताज़े हिम या दुग्‍ध के सामन), सफ़ेद, श्‍वेत, चिट्टा] 34:T10e4, The correct answer is **'have given; of their'.**
